purpose: Cross-programme evidence inventory; no novel pooled effects, no reclassification of frozen primary outcomes

status_vocab.primary_support: Prospectively selected primary outcome, as qualified by study-specific criteria
status_vocab.qualified_support: Original source and target qualified, with explicit estimator/provenance restriction
status_vocab.retrospective_support: Reanalysis after previous outcomes known, not independent confirmatory test
status_vocab.mixed_or_no_generalization: Positive cross-site/heldout criterion not established or fails; not a biological zero

claims.caveat: Verified source-only GitHub Actions succeeded (synthetic tests 8/8), but anonymous official ORNL leaf CSV returned HTTP 401; source original-data eligibility unverified. No K or FD→wood stock model fitted; data-access HOLD, not evidence of zero ecological effect.

claims.unit: All 201 frozen family×trait systems; 45 families, 12 continuous traits; 49 source-contaminated recomputed and 152 unchanged
claims.estimand: source-validity corrected BIEN distance–trait dissimilarity rho, crossed family repeatability and same-fold held-out-family BLUP SSE gain on raw/log state representations
claims.caveat: Data-validity correction frozen before cleaned outcomes. Full corrected 201 rho/SE table recovered from original job stdout with no source species rows republished; all corrected-row, impact and raw/log sampling-variance checks pass. A re-run of the three unchanged original R models matched all 30 frozen Stage B model statistics exactly (PR #67, Actions #44542568468). This confirms numerical reproducibility, not independent biological replication or causality. RC3 stays blocked and RC4 still needs visually reviewed anonymous DOCX/PDF, rights and author approval.

claims.unit: 40 original mixtures, 14 trait species and 34 original planted composition holdout groups, one Canadian experiment
claims.estimand: same-plot and same-composition-fold FD incremental SSE prediction: NDE (signed) versus absolute biomass, plus selection and complementarity, adjusted for planted richness and mean SLA/height
claims.caveat: Source-verified separate retrospective and outcome-aware **single-study** pilot. All individual and paired 95% intervals cross zero; hypothesized better NDE prediction not supported, and opposite point sign is not conclusive. 34 composition holdouts are not 34 studies. Bootstrap resamples heldout errors without refitting. Pre-sown two-trait FD is an attribute of planted species, not an independently randomized FD intervention. Prior Cadotte selection/complementarity relationship already published; no new causal inference or global FD biomass generality.

claims.unit: 2025 Nature author-published meta-analysis, 4598 original no-outlier mixture rows/452 StudyIDs. Fixed model complete-case cohorts: leaf N 1709 observations/116 author StudyIDs; SLA 2031/127 author StudyIDs.
claims.estimand: Extra predictive study-equal held-out-study squared error gain when a priori planted-species RaoQ functional diversity is added beyond richness, PD, CWM, N-fixer mix, stand age, ecosystem and climate, for signed CE vs signed SE with identical original StudyID folds

observations.v02_identifiability_adjustment: remove the exact redundant PlantType dummy, keep Eco1; source row/fold and numerical gates unchanged before outcomes

claims.caveat: Retrospective predictive analysis on SAME originally published meta-analysis, not an independent original biological replication. Authors' earlier FD-vs-CE positive associations need not imply FD incremental holdout improvement. Pairwise CE-vs-SE gain difference intervals include zero, and leaf N FD worsens SE prediction score, not biologically suppressing selection. Original StudyID not independently verified unique article, source original outcome-based outlier removal 82 rows and substantial complete-case attrition (116/213 leaf N StudyIDs) limit generality. Study cluster 2000 bootstrap of fixed predictions omits refit uncertainty. No FD-only randomized treatment or phylogenetic-memory FD causal path.

claims.unit: One original Wagg et al. 2017 Jena Trait-Based Experiment: 138 source plots, 24 original pool-specific monocultures, 84 eligible mixture plot units in 6 matched pool×richness strata; 2012 May+August annual sown dry biomass g/m²
claims.estimand: Same-source high (wFDc 3–4) vs low (wFDc 1–2) assigned trait-disparity composition contrast, adjusted for source pool×richness and uncertified plot-prefix A/B/C source coding: observed annual biomass = same-pool mono expected yield + net diversity effect; NDE = Loreau–Hector complementarity CE + selection SE
claims.caveat: This reanalysis's source-certification gate required 3 verified physical Block levels and remains HOLD: the literal PANGAEA Block field has one; Plot A/B/C 46×3 are proxies NOT verified randomized physical blocks (JEXIS 739 timeout). A separate pre-fixed exploratory source-based contrast bundles assigned species identities with FD, so cannot identify a pure scalar FD causal intervention. All five plot-bootstrap intervals cross zero; source monos one original plot per species×pool so their yield-estimation uncertainty is not resampled. Already analyzed in original Wagg et al. 2017; one Jena experimental field (not 3 independent sites). The positive NDE contrast and negative high-minus-low expected-yield contrast reproduce the observed biomass contrast algebraically; this is not confirmed ecological compensation, external replication or rho/K→FD→biomass mediation.
